svg.title: How Ottto works
svg.desc: Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents write session files and telemetry on your Macs; the Ottto service on each Mac reads them and sends only usage metadata and optional labels to your Ottto account, while prompts, code, transcripts and sign-in tokens never leave the Mac; the same service also runs on your servers, for coding agents or any AI agent in production, and your org admin can connect Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI billing and usage directly to the account, which prices your usage and shows it in the web app (costs, plan limits, session optimizations, families, graphs and automations), recommendations to save money and improve agent quality, and a plugin for Claude and any AI agent.
